name: kernelcad
description: Agent-first CAD over the hosted kernelCAD MCP: editable .kcad.ts source, design_loop review, cookbooks, Studio viewer and STEP/STL/3MF export. No local OpenCASCADE install.

interface.longDescription: Agent-first CAD over the hosted kernelCAD MCP: editable .kcad.ts source, design_loop review, cookbooks, Studio viewer and STEP/STL/3MF export. No local OpenCASCADE install.
defaultPrompt: Design a 3D-printable phone stand with kernelCAD and open it in Studio.
Find a kernelCAD cookbook for a NEMA 17 motor plate and build it.
Export my bracket as STEP and 3MF.

test_cases.description: Mounting plate with four clearance holes
test_cases.prompt: Design a 60 × 40 × 5 mm mounting plate with four M4 clearance holes 5 mm from the corners.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Model builds, the 3D view shows a plate with 4 holes, and the evaluate result is green.

test_cases.description: Printability review for FDM and CNC
test_cases.prompt: Is it printable on a Bambu A1 mini? Check it for CNC too.
test_cases.expected_behavior: A dfm_review checklist with pass/fail rows. The plate passes FDM, and CNC is flagged only if there are sharp internal corners.

test_cases.prompt: Give me a STEP file and a PDF drawing.
test_cases.expected_behavior: STEP and pdf-drawing exports with download links, and dimensions on the drawing.

test_cases.prompt: Make it 3 mm thicker and add 2 mm fillets on the outer edges.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The model updates, and a diff shows the change.

test_cases.prompt: Add a 10 mm hole through the middle of this. (attach bracket.step)
test_cases.expected_behavior: import_step brings the file in as the base body, then the hole is added.

test_cases.prompt: Order 10 of these from JLC3DP and pay with my card.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not charge a card. Any order is created only after the user confirms the price, and they pay through their own pay link.
import_step refuses the private host and asks for a public link or an attached file.

publication.release_notes: Hosted kernelCAD MCP: editable .kcad.ts models, design review, DFM checks, STEP/STL/3MF/GLB/DXF/PDF export and fab-pack quote links.
